name: guards
description: Denies Bash commands that change more than the agent knows about, each with the narrower command to run instead: git add -A / --all / ., git commit -a, chezmoi apply --force without a target, and on Windows a doubled backslash the Bash tool would halve. A PR merge (gh, glab, their APIs, auto-merge) waits for a code review recorded for the exact head it merges.
